item.name: Categories
item.description: Protected category routes. Run Login - Success or Register - Success first to populate auth_token.

request.description: Lists categories for the authenticated user.
Creates a category. Name is trimmed and color is normalized to lowercase. Stores returned id in category_id.

response.name: 201 Created

request.description: Shows a single category scoped to the authenticated user.
Updates category name and color. PUT is also supported.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Updates category using PUT.
Partial updates are allowed. Supplied fields must pass the same rules.
Deletes a category scoped to the authenticated user.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Unauthorized
422 Unprocessable Entity
422 Unprocessable Entity

request.description: Category names are unique per user after trimming and lowercasing. Work, work, WORK, and WoRk conflict.

response.name: 422 Unprocessable Entity

request.description: Returned when the category does not exist, the ID is malformed, or the category belongs to another user.

response.name: 404 Not Found

item.name: Notes
item.description: Protected note routes. Run Login - Success or Register - Success first to populate auth_token. Notes belong to the authenticated user and one owned category.

request.description: Lists notes for the authenticated user.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Lists notes filtered by category_id. The category must belong to the authenticated user.
Creates a note. title and content are trimmed. Stores returned id in note_id. content may be omitted or null.

response.name: 201 Created

request.description: Creates a note with nullable content.
Shows a single note scoped to the authenticated user.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Updates category_id, title, and content. PUT is also supported. category_id must belong to the authenticated user.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Updates note using PUT.
Partial updates are allowed. This clears content.
Deletes a note scoped to the authenticated user.

response.name: 200 OK
401 Unauthorized
